answer: Because the meadow release is recorded with every signature, the cipher audit reveals the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the cedar graph and each risks its bond. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 7 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 11 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
